limitations: Timestamps identify the documented source measurement clock; interval start/end semantics remain unknown.
Historical publication, availability and decision-maker receipt are unknown; no receipt times are inferred.
Wind FROM/TO convention, sensor height and fire-front representativeness are unverified.
Mean wind is not gust data or an engine wind index; no simulator conversion is performed.
Finite exported values do not establish sensor completeness or quality flags. No values are imputed.

Chart fecha carries +02:00 serialization offsets; these are not treated as measurement timezone evidence. The manual establishes the displayed UTC clock, and fechaStr plus the official parser establish calendar rollover.

timezone_evidence.scope: Displayed hourly/subdaily clock is UTC from 2014-04-01 onward.

timestamp_mapping: weather.json records[*].provenance maps every source row; chart_evidence_pointer refers to chart_evidence.json when present.

reproduction.without_chart_evidence: Omit all four chart arguments to leave eight 24:00 timestamps unknown for the full source.

source_evidence.finding: The pinned official HTML exposes a separate resultadoConsultaChart series with fecha, fechaStr, hora and all five measurements for all 384 rows.
source_evidence.calendar_verification: The audited official script parseFechaHora explicitly constructs day+1 at 00:00 for fechaStr hour 24:00. All eight alternate chart labels identify the preceding day, independently of table row order.
source_evidence.timezone_interpretation: UTC comes from the official manual's displayed-clock convention. The chart's literal +02:00 offset is preserved as evidence, not converted as a measurement timezone. This establishes the source clock label, not interval start/end or receipt.
source_evidence.html_policy: Original CSRF-bearing HTML is an input hash/reference only; sanitized chart_evidence.json copies whitelisted timestamps and numeric measurements, never forms, cookies or tokens.
source_evidence.live_query: Only the observed public chart/export script was fetched anonymously; no saved/account query was made.
